subject.title: Plugin Hooks: Missing trace context for observability (messageId, runId in all hooks, parentSpanId)

question: What single additive Plugin SDK trace-correlation contract should OpenClaw expose across agent lifecycle, outbound message, and subagent hooks?
rationale: The missing behavior is a public plugin API design choice, not just a mechanical field addition, because it affects hook event shape, trace hierarchy semantics, docs, and compatibility expectations for observability plugins.

options.title: Design one cross-hook contract
options.body: Adopt one documented trace correlation shape for lifecycle, outbound message, and subagent hooks before implementing the remaining fields.

options.title: Split into narrow hook issues
options.body: Keep this umbrella open only as tracking and move each remaining hook-family field into a narrower implementation issue.

options.title: Defer new public fields
options.body: Leave the current partial runId/trace coverage in place and wait for stronger observability plugin requirements before expanding the Plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Design one cross-hook contract
recommendation.body: Adopt one documented trace correlation shape for lifecycle, outbound message, and subagent hooks before implementing the remaining fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged trace carrier work is the most direct current-main foundation for the remaining Plugin SDK trace-correlation contract.
